source_law.text: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency, making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of every other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Yield the right-of-way.

Eight exact pinned offline commands, 480-frame synthetic saved finalizations, exact v1 Core/Lean/video positives and missing-source negatives, retained error logs and independent audits pass. These are unselected diagnostic proofs; strict v2 recipe receipts, original vehicle authority and qualifying lamp pixels, physical Native behavior and legal outcome remain unverified worker-owned work.
